steel_slag.name: Steel Slag (BF/BOF)
steel_slag.substitutes_for: cement clinker / GGBS component, road base aggregate
steel_slag.note: Well-documented Tata/JSW practice; displaces clinker in blended cement.

fly_ash.name: Fly Ash (Class F)
fly_ash.note: MoEFCC Fly Ash Notification 2009 (as amended 2016/2021): mandatory utilisation within 300 km radius of the thermal power station for construction/ash-based products.

spent_brewery_grain.name: Spent Brewery Grain (BSG)
spent_brewery_grain.note: Highly perishable (ferments in ~48h) - short storage_days window forces fast deals.

textile_dyeing_sludge.name: Textile Dyeing Sludge (ETP sludge)
textile_dyeing_sludge.substitutes_for: alternative fuel/raw material in cement kiln co-processing
textile_dyeing_sludge.note: Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management & Transboundary Movement) Rules, 2016 - requires CPCB-authorised co-processing/TSDF facility with a valid hazardous-waste handling license.

foundry_sand.name: Spent Foundry Sand
foundry_sand.note: Widely reused in paver blocks and construction fill across Peenya/Hosur belt.

lime_sludge.name: Paper Mill Lime Sludge
lime_sludge.note: Avoided limestone calcination CO2 is the dominant climate benefit.

rice_husk.name: Rice Husk
rice_husk.note: High calorific value; displaces coal directly in captive boilers.

rice_husk_ash.name: Rice Husk Ash
rice_husk_ash.note: High amorphous silica content (~90%) makes this valuable, not just waste.

dairy_manure_whey.name: Dairy Manure & Whey
dairy_manure_whey.note: Methane-capture pathway avoids uncontrolled venting; perishable, needs quick offtake.

biogas.name: Biogas (boiler-grade)
biogas.substitutes_for: furnace oil / LPG for boiler heating (tonne oil-equivalent basis)
biogas.note: Seller economics come from tipping/offtake revenue, not disposal avoidance.

cement_kiln_dust.name: Cement Kiln Dust (CKD)
cement_kiln_dust.note: Low-value but high-volume; the demonstration cascade's third leg.
